tasks.name: Submission open
tasks.notes: Uploading of images may begin, payments must be made by October 25th - otherwise the team is removed from the competition

tasks.name: National teams entries closed
tasks.notes: National Teams entries should now be closed to allow time for the Team Captain to gather RAW images and finalise Team entry before October 31.

tasks.name: Category validation
tasks.notes: Brief category validation. Looking for obvious wrong categories/ obvious issues with rules etc. Overview process only.

tasks.name: Cut off date for team captains to replace images
tasks.notes: Cut off date for team captains to replace images that were challenged during the validation process.

tasks.name: Team members + images may be promoted
tasks.notes: If an image is disqualified from this point – there is no replacement available to the team. A disqualified photographer is still considered a team member

tasks.name: Major validation
tasks.notes: Major validation of Top 15 images in each category

tasks.name: Finalist announcement
tasks.notes: Finalist announcement made. Social Media slides available.

tasks.name: BON announcement
tasks.notes: Best of Nation photographer announcements made on YouTube/Facebook. Social media slides made available.

tasks.name: Award ceremony
tasks.notes: Award presentation in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. The WPC award show is held in conjunction with the Canadian Imaging Conference & Expo 2027
